selected_source: Earliest true source: Announcement Form 8-K Exhibit 2.1 Merger Agreement or Exhibit 99.1 press release if the full cash/stock election menu is stated. If not complete there, use the first S-4/S-4A/424B3/DEFM14A that states the final election menu.
backup_sources: S-4/S-4A, 424B3/final prospectus, DEFM14A/proxy, election form/letter of transmittal
phase: Announcement package if present there; otherwise election-making/proxy-registration process
selection_rule: If all sources agree, pick the earliest filed document. If announcement materials are incomplete or later amended, pick the earliest document whose menu matches the final operative terms.

selected_source: Earliest true source: Announcement Form 8-K Exhibit 2.1 Merger Agreement or Exhibit 99.1 press release. If the cash amount is only finalized later, use the earliest S-4/S-4A/424B3/DEFM14A with final value.
backup_sources: S-4/S-4A, 424B3, DEFM14A, offer to purchase/Schedule TO-T for tender offers
phase: Announcement package; later corrected/finalized during election-making if amended
selection_rule: Use announcement value only if it is identical to final operative documents. If changed, earlier stale value is retained as conflict evidence but not selected.

selected_source: Earliest true source: Announcement Form 8-K Exhibit 2.1 Merger Agreement or Exhibit 99.1 press release if it states shares/value offered. If formulaic, use the earliest document stating the final stock consideration mechanics.
backup_sources: S-4/S-4A, 424B3, DEFM14A, merger proxy/prospectus
phase: Announcement package; otherwise election-making/proxy-registration process
selection_rule: Pick the earliest document that states the final stock consideration. For floating value/collar deals, retain the formula and pricing period instead of forcing a fixed per-share number.

selected_source: Earliest true source: Announcement Form 8-K Exhibit 2.1 Merger Agreement or Exhibit 99.1 press release. For amended/collar/floating structures, use the earliest filing that states the final ratio or final ratio formula.
backup_sources: S-4/S-4A, 424B3, DEFM14A, merger agreement amendments
phase: Announcement package; or election-making if ratio is finalized/amended later
selection_rule: If fixed ratio appears consistently, select earliest. If ratio changes, select earliest document with the final operative ratio/formula.

selected_source: Earliest true source: Announcement Form 8-K Exhibit 2.1 Merger Agreement if it states aggregate cash cap or maximum cash election amount. If not explicit/clean, use earliest S-4/S-4A/424B3/DEFM14A with final cap.
backup_sources: S-4/S-4A, 424B3, DEFM14A, election form, letter of transmittal
phase: Announcement package if in merger agreement; otherwise election-making/proxy-registration process
selection_rule: DEFM14A/424B3 often provides the cleanest summary, but selected_source should still be the earliest document containing the final cap value.

selected_source: Earliest true source: Announcement Form 8-K Exhibit 2.1 Merger Agreement if it states aggregate stock cap or maximum stock election amount. If not explicit/clean, use earliest S-4/S-4A/424B3/DEFM14A with final cap.
backup_sources: S-4/S-4A, 424B3, DEFM14A, election form, letter of transmittal
phase: Announcement package if in merger agreement; otherwise election-making/proxy-registration process
selection_rule: Use earliest final value; flag differences between agreement, prospectus, and final election form.

selected_source: Earliest true source: Announcement Form 8-K Exhibit 2.1 Merger Agreement if the actual formula is stated. Otherwise use earliest S-4/S-4A/424B3/DEFM14A or letter of transmittal/election form with final proration mechanics.
backup_sources: DEFM14A, 424B3, S-4/S-4A, letter of transmittal, election form, Schedule TO-T/offer to purchase
phase: Announcement package if formula is in the merger agreement; otherwise election-making process
selection_rule: Do not select vague announcement language. Select the earliest filing with an actual computable formula and final cap definitions.

selected_source: Earliest true source: first S-4/S-4A/424B3/DEFM14A/election form/letter of transmittal that states how non-electing shares are treated. Merger agreement may be selected only if it clearly states the rule.
backup_sources: DEFM14A, 424B3, S-4/S-4A, election form, letter of transmittal, Schedule TO-T/offer to purchase
phase: Usually election-making/proxy-registration process; rarely announcement package
selection_rule: This field can flip the trade sign. Prefer the earliest explicit and operational rule, not a vague summary.

selected_source: Earliest true source: election form, letter of transmittal, offer to purchase, or Schedule TO-T that states the final election/expiration deadline. If deadline is extended, use the earliest extension 8-K/press release that states the new final deadline.
backup_sources: DEFM14A, 424B3, S-4/S-4A, Form 425 communications, 8-K/EX-99.1 extension notices
phase: Election-making process; extension notices may appear during election-making or immediately before completion
selection_rule: If the deadline changes, the original deadline is stale. Selected value should be the earliest filing containing the final operative deadline.

selected_source: Earliest true source: DEFM14A/proxy notice or S-4/proxy-prospectus that states shareholder record date. For tender offers, may be N/A unless a vote/record holder concept applies.
backup_sources: S-4/S-4A, 424B3, PREM14A, Form 425 proxy communications
phase: Election-making/proxy-registration process
selection_rule: Select earliest document with the final record date used for voting/election eligibility. Flag preliminary proxy dates if final proxy changes them.

selected_source: Earliest true source: letter of transmittal, offer to purchase, or Schedule TO-T/TO-T-A exhibit that states odd-lot priority. Often N/A for standard merger elections.
backup_sources: Election form, notice of guaranteed delivery, SC 14D-9, 424B3/DEFM14A if summarized
phase: Election-making process
selection_rule: Do not infer. Return N/A unless the offer/election material explicitly grants odd-lot priority.

selected_source: Earliest true source: notice of guaranteed delivery, letter of transmittal, offer to purchase, or Schedule TO-T exhibit that states guaranteed delivery rules/window. Often N/A in non-tender merger elections.
backup_sources: Election form, Schedule TO-T/TO-T-A, SC 14D-9, 424B3/DEFM14A if summarized
phase: Election-making process
selection_rule: Select explicit window/rule only. If no guaranteed-delivery mechanism exists, return N/A with evidence.

selected_source: Earliest true source: post-deadline Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 press release or standalone press release announcing preliminary election/proration results.
backup_sources: 8-K, 8-K/A, issuer/acquirer press release, Form 425 if filed as communication
phase: Completion/post-election statement stage
selection_rule: This is a post-election label, not a pre-trade feature. Select earliest preliminary result; later final result is separate.

selected_source: Earliest true source: Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 press release/final proration announcement after election deadline or at closing.
backup_sources: 8-K/A, closing 8-K, issuer/acquirer press release, final proration statement
phase: Completion/post-election statement stage
selection_rule: If preliminary and final differ, select earliest document that states final results, not the preliminary announcement.

selected_source: Earliest true source: post-deadline 8-K Exhibit 99.1 or final proration press release stating number/percentage of shares electing cash.
backup_sources: 8-K/A, final proration results statement, closing 8-K
phase: Completion/post-election statement stage
selection_rule: If only final proration factor is given but not demand, return null/not_found unless computable from disclosed totals.

selected_source: Earliest true source: post-deadline 8-K Exhibit 99.1 or final proration press release stating number/percentage of shares electing stock.
backup_sources: 8-K/A, final proration results statement, closing 8-K
phase: Completion/post-election statement stage
selection_rule: If only final proration factor is given but not demand, return null/not_found unless computable from disclosed totals.

selected_source: Earliest true source: closing Form 8-K/EX-99.1 completion press release, or termination Form 8-K/EX-99.1 if broken.
backup_sources: 8-K/A, merger closing press release, termination press release, Bloomberg/WRDS status field
phase: Completion/post-election statement stage
selection_rule: Announcement expected-closing language is not enough. Select actual completion or termination statement.

selected_source: Market data file/API: target ticker daily/intraday OHLCV from Bloomberg, WRDS/CRSP, TAQ, Polygon, Refinitiv, or equivalent. Not in SEC transaction filing.
backup_sources: Exchange historical data, Yahoo/yfinance for prototype only
phase: Pre-announcement and continuously through election-making; selected as-of each trade date
selection_rule: Use the earliest market-data timestamp required by the model window, but for trading signal use only prices timestamped before decision time.

selected_source: Market data file/API: acquirer ticker daily/intraday OHLCV from Bloomberg, WRDS/CRSP, TAQ, Polygon, Refinitiv, or equivalent. Not in SEC transaction filing.
backup_sources: Exchange historical data, Yahoo/yfinance for prototype only
phase: Pre-announcement and continuously through election-making; selected as-of each trade date
selection_rule: Use price available before trade decision. Needed for stock consideration value S = exchange_ratio × acquirer_price.

selected_source: Computed pipeline file, not a raw filing: deal_spread = predicted/contract value minus target_price, using legal terms plus target/acquirer prices.
backup_sources: Bloomberg/WRDS merger-arb spread fields if available, internal calculation from terms + prices
phase: First meaningful during/after announcement; updated continuously during election-making
selection_rule: Earliest after the consideration terms and both prices are available. Must be recomputed when acquirer price or terms change.

selected_source: Market data file/API: target and acquirer volume, dollar volume, bid-ask spread, ADV, TAQ/Level-1/Level-2 where available. Not in SEC transaction filing.
backup_sources: Bloomberg/WRDS/CRSP/TAQ/Polygon/Refinitiv
phase: Pre-announcement and continuously through election-making
selection_rule: Use as-of historical market data only. Choose measures consistent with execution date and backtest frequency.

selected_source: Borrow/lending vendor file/API: Bloomberg securities lending, S3, DataLend, Markit/IHS, Prime broker feed. Not in SEC transaction filing.
backup_sources: Short-fee proxies from vendor, hard-to-borrow indicators, securities-lending desk data
phase: Pre-announcement and continuously through election-making; selected as-of trade date
selection_rule: Use point-in-time borrow fee available before trade. Do not substitute post-trade realized borrow cost unless labeling execution.

selected_source: Borrow/lending vendor file/API or prime broker locate/availability feed. Not in SEC transaction filing.
backup_sources: Bloomberg/S3/DataLend/Markit/prime broker inventory, indicative locate data
phase: Pre-announcement and continuously through election-making; selected as-of trade date
selection_rule: Use availability known before trade; flag if only indicative or not executable.

selected_source: FINRA short interest report or vendor file that mirrors FINRA/exchange short-interest data. Not in SEC transaction filing.
backup_sources: Bloomberg/FactSet/Refinitiv short interest fields, exchange short interest files
phase: Pre-announcement and election-making, but lagged relative to settlement/reporting schedule
selection_rule: Use only the latest report publicly available before the trade decision, not the later settlement period if unpublished then.

selected_source: Computed ownership-classification file using latest available 13F holdings, ETF holdings, index membership, and manager taxonomy. Not in SEC transaction filing.
backup_sources: Bloomberg ownership, WRDS institutional holdings, SEC 13F-HR, ETF sponsor holdings, index constituent files
phase: Pre-announcement / latest available before election-making; lagged for 13F, fresher for ETF daily holdings
selection_rule: Select the latest point-in-time ownership snapshot available before decision time; compute passive share using manager/fund classification rules.

selected_source: ETF daily holdings files from Bloomberg/WRDS/ETF sponsors if available; otherwise latest 13F/ownership feed for ETF holders. Not in SEC transaction filing.
backup_sources: Bloomberg ETF holdings, ETF sponsor daily holdings CSV, WRDS, 13F-HR for ETF managers
phase: Pre-announcement and election-making; ideally daily/fresh as-of trade date
selection_rule: Prefer ETF daily holdings over 13F if both exist. Use point-in-time files available before trade decision.

selected_source: Computed manager-type ownership file using latest available SEC 13F-HR or Bloomberg/WRDS institutional ownership plus hedge-fund/event-driven manager classification.
backup_sources: 13F-HR, WRDS 13F, Bloomberg ownership, FactSet ownership, manual manager taxonomy
phase: Pre-announcement / latest available before election-making; lagged
selection_rule: Use filing publication date as availability date. Do not treat quarter-end holdings as available before the 13F filing is public.

selected_source: SEC Form N-PORT XML/filing or structured N-PORT data/API for registered funds holding target shares; extract position/fund-level securities-on-loan value where available. Not in SEC transaction filing.
backup_sources: SEC EDGAR N-PORT, SEC N-PORT data sets, sec-api N-PORT API, Bloomberg fund lending if available
phase: Pre-announcement / latest public report before election-making; lagged
selection_rule: Use only N-PORT reports publicly disseminated before decision time. Map fund holdings to target security and aggregate on-loan amounts.

selected_source: Fund SAI (Statement of Additional Information), prospectus, annual/semiannual report, or fund securities-lending policy document. Not in SEC transaction filing.
backup_sources: Fund SAI on EDGAR (N-1A-related filings), fund website securities-lending policy, annual report, N-CEN where relevant
phase: Pre-announcement/static standing document; use latest effective version before trade decision
selection_rule: Select the latest effective policy available before decision time; summarize recall/discretion/lending limits if stated.

selected_source: MSLA/GMSLA template plus fund SAI/lending agreement disclosure explaining who controls voting/election/recall rights on lent shares. Not in SEC transaction filing.
backup_sources: Fund SAI/prospectus language, securities lending agreement disclosure, legal template, counsel memo, manual legal research
phase: Pre-announcement/static legal control assumption; resolved before model build
selection_rule: This is not usually a deal-specific numeric field. Store as legal assumption/evidence: retained fund rights, borrower rights, recall mechanics, and uncertainty flag.
